import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a 'Fraud Status' column for better legend labels in KDE plots
df['Fraud Status'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

# Set a style for better aesthetics
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')

# Set up the matplotlib figure and axes for subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(20, 7))

# Subplot 1: Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='amount', hue='Fraud Status', fill=True, common_norm=False, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis', linewidth=2)
axes[0].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amount by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[0].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='10')

# Subplot 2: Distribution of Transaction Hour by Fraud Status
sns.kdeplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', hue='Fraud Status', fill=True, common_norm=False, ax=axes[1], palette='plasma', linewidth=2)
axes[1].set_title('Distribution of Transaction Hour by Fraud Status', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[1].legend(title='Fraud Status', title_fontsize='12', fontsize='10')

# Subplot 3: Fraud Rate by Transaction Type
fraud_rate_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].mean().reset_index()
sns.barplot(data=fraud_rate_by_type, x='transaction_type', y='is_fraud', ax=axes[2], palette='cividis')
axes[2].set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
axes[2].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[2].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (Proportion)', fontsize=12)
axes[2].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=10, rotation=45) # Rotate for better readability
axes[2].tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
axes[2].set_ylim(0, 1) # Ensure y-axis for proportion is from 0 to 1

# Add an overall title to the figure
plt.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Analysis: Key Patterns', fontsize=18, y=1.02)

# Adjust layout to prevent overlap and provide sufficient spacing
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
